The main takeaway from our work is that
the meaning of action word is not an abstract representation, but rather a dynamic pattern of motor control that is grounded in the interaction of the agent with the environment.
grounding action words in the sensorimotor interaction with the environment is a plausible mechanism to explain how the meaning of action verbs could be learned by the human infant.
the grounding process of action words is not a process that happens in the mind of the agent, but it is a process that happens through the interaction of the agent with its environment.
